# S35 — adj context size budget

Add adj context --max-bytes N: keep the newest decided records whose output fits in N bytes, print them in ID order, and say how many were left out.

**Findings:** PROJECT.md Non-goals (not in 0.1.0: size budget flag); Risks: context bloat · **Size:** S · **Tree:** cli

**Not in this slice:** any other read command; changing the default output when --max-bytes is not given (it must stay byte-identical); token counting; slicer catalog records (S34 runs in parallel and would take the same catalog id: record C32 decisions as slicer notes on S35; the outer session files them in the catalog at landing).
